grep SumGF /bioinformatics/ryley/Algorithm_Benchmark/fusion_calling/LongGF/LongGF*SGNex*K562*.log > /bioinformatics/ryley/LongGF.K562.Nanopore.tsv
grep SumGF /bioinformatics/ryley/Algorithm_Benchmark/fusion_calling/LongGF/LongGF*SGNex*MCF7*.log > /bioinformatics/ryley/LongGF.MCF7.Nanopore.tsv
grep SumGF /bioinformatics/ryley/Algorithm_Benchmark/fusion_calling/LongGF/LongGF*MCF7*ENCODE*.log > /bioinformatics/ryley/LongGF.MCF7.PacBio.tsv

grep SumGF /bioinformatics/ryley/Algorithm_Benchmark/fusion_calling/LongGF/LongGF*MCF7*ENCODE*.log

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(biomaRt)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggforce)
library(UpSetR)
library(ComplexUpset)
```
```{r}
known_fusions <- read.table("~/benchmark_data_analysis/real_gene_fusions.tsv", header=TRUE)
ensembl <- useMart("ensembl", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")
```

```{r}
####Read in Data
#LongGF
my_files <- list.files(path = "/bioinformatics/ryley", pattern = "LongGF", full.names=TRUE)
all_tsv <-lapply(my_files, read.table)
names(all_tsv) <- gsub(".tsv","",list.files(path = "/bioinformatics/ryley", pattern = "LongGF",full.names = FALSE),fixed = TRUE)
names <- gsub(".tsv","", list.files(path = "/bioinformatics/ryley", pattern = "LongGF",full.names = FALSE),fixed = TRUE)
for(i in names){
  assign(i, read.table(paste0("/bioinformatics/ryley/", i, ".tsv")))
}
LongGF <- do.call(rbind, lapply(my_files, function(filename) {
  read.table(filename) %>%
    mutate(Source = basename(filename))
}))

LongGF$V1[LongGF$V1=="SumGF"] <- "/bioinformatics/ryley/Algorithm_Benchmark/fusion_calling/LongGF/LongGF.run.MCF7_ENCODE_ENCFF887DGG_PacBio.log:SumGF"
LongGF <- LongGF %>% mutate(Source = sub("^.*\\.run\\.(.*?)\\.log.*$", "\\1", V1))

#Genion
myfiles<- list.files(path = "/bioinformatics/ryley/Algorithm_Benchmark/fusion_calling/Genion", pattern = "*_genion", full.names = TRUE)
file_list <- myfiles[!grepl("SRX905986", myfiles)]
Genion<- do.call(rbind, lapply(file_list, function(filename) {
  if (file.info(filename)$size > 0) {
    read.table(filename) %>%
      mutate(Source = sub("_genion$", "", basename(filename)))
  } else {
    NULL
  }
}))


#JAFFAL
myfiles<-list.files(path = "/bioinformatics/ryley/Algorithm_Benchmark/fusion_calling/jaffal_results_cell_lines", pattern = "jaffa_results.csv", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
JAFFAL <-  do.call(rbind, lapply(myfiles, function(filename) {
  read.table(filename, header = TRUE, sep = ",") %>%
    mutate(Source =  sub("^jaffal_results_cell_lines", "",sub(".fastq$", "",sample)))
}))
#JAFFAL_3Gene 
myfiles<-list.files(path = "/bioinformatics/ryley/Algorithm_Benchmark/fusion_calling", pattern = ".3gene_summary", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE) %>%
  grep(pattern = "cell_lines", x = ., value = TRUE)

JAFFAL_3Gene <- do.call(rbind, lapply(myfiles, function(filename) {
  read.table(filename, header = TRUE, sep = "\t") %>%
    mutate(Source = sub("^jaffal_results_cell_lines", "",sub(".fastq$", "", basename(dirname(filename)))))
}))

#fusionseeker
myfiles<-list.files(path = "/bioinformatics/ryley/Algorithm_Benchmark/fusion_calling/FusionSeeker", pattern = "confident_genefusion.txt", full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
FusionSeeker <- do.call(rbind, lapply(myfiles, function(filename){
  read.table(filename, header = TRUE) %>% mutate(Source = sub("^fusionseeker_", "", basename(dirname(filename))))
}))

LongGF <- LongGF %>%
  mutate(Platform = case_when(
    grepl("PacBio", Source, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "PacBio",
    !grepl("PacBio", Source, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Nanopore"), Cell_Lines = case_when(
    grepl("K562", Source, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "K562",
    grepl("MCF7", Source, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "MCF7",# Keep original value if no match
  ), Algorithm = "LongGF")
Genion <- Genion%>%
  mutate(Platform = case_when(
    grepl("PacBio", Source, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "PacBio",
    !grepl("PacBio", Source, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Nanopore"), Cell_Lines = case_when(
    grepl("K562", Source, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "K562",
    grepl("MCF7", Source, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "MCF7",# Keep original value if no match
  ), Algorithm = "Genion")

FusionSeeker <- FusionSeeker %>%
  mutate(Platform = case_when(
    grepl("PacBio", Source, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "PacBio",
    !grepl("PacBio", Source, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Nanopore"), Cell_Lines = case_when(
    grepl("K562", Source, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "K562",
    grepl("MCF7", Source, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "MCF7",# Keep original value if no match
  ), Algorithm = "FusionSeeker")

JAFFAL <- JAFFAL%>%
  mutate(Source = sample, Platform = case_when(
    grepl("PacBio", sample, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "PacBio",
    !grepl("PacBio", sample, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Nanopore"), Cell_Lines = case_when(
    grepl("K562", sample, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "K562",
    grepl("MCF7", sample, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "MCF7",# Keep original value if no match
  ))

JAFFAL_3Gene <- JAFFAL_3Gene %>%
  mutate(Platform = case_when(
    grepl("PacBio", Source, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "PacBio",
    !grepl("PacBio", Source, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Nanopore"), Cell_Lines = case_when(
    grepl("K562", Source, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "K562",
    grepl("MCF7", Source, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "MCF7",# Keep original value if no match
  ))

```

```{r}
#find impossible fusions chrM x genomic genes, and mitochondrial chimeras
impossible_chimeras_FusionSeeker <- subset(FusionSeeker, (Chrom1 == "chrM" & Chrom2 != "chrM") | (Chrom1 != "chrM" & Chrom2 == "chrM")) %>% mutate(fusionType = "Impossible")

impossible_chimeras_LongGF <- filter(LongGF, (grepl("chrM:", V4, ignore.case = TRUE) & !grepl("chrM:", V5, ignore.case = TRUE)) | (!grepl("chrM:", V4, ignore.case = TRUE) & grepl("chrM:", V5, ignore.case = TRUE))) %>% mutate(fusionType = "Impossible")

mito_chimeras_FusionSeeker <- subset(FusionSeeker, (Chrom1 == "chrM" & Chrom2 == "chrM")) %>% mutate(fusionType = "Mitochondrial")

mito_chimeras_LongGF <- filter(LongGF, (grepl("chrM:", V4, ignore.case = TRUE) & grepl("chrM:", V5, ignore.case = TRUE))) %>% mutate(fusionType = "Mitochondrial")

mito_chimeras_Genion <- filter(Genion, grepl("M:", V8, ignore.case = TRUE))
mito_chimeras_JAFFAL <- subset(JAFFAL, (chrom1=="chrM" | chrom2=="chrM")) 

mito_chimeras <- rbind(impossible_chimeras_LongGF[c(3, 6:10)], mito_chimeras_LongGF[c(3, 6:10)])
mito_chimeras$NumSupp <-mito_chimeras$V3
mito_chimeras <-mito_chimeras[2:7] %>% rbind(mito_chimeras_FusionSeeker[c(4,10:14)], impossible_chimeras_FusionSeeker[c(4,10:14)])
```

```{r}
ggplot(filter(mito_chimeras, NumSupp >=2), aes(x = Algorithm, fill = fusionType)) +
  geom_bar() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "False calls by each algorithm", subtitle = "minimum read support of 2", x = "Fusion Type", y = "Count")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))+
  facet_wrap( ~Cell_Lines)

ggplot(filter(mito_chimeras, NumSupp >=3), aes(x = Algorithm, fill = fusionType)) +
  geom_bar() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "False calls by each algorithm", subtitle = "minimum read support of 2", x = "Fusion Type", y = "Count")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))+
  facet_wrap( ~Cell_Lines)

ggplot(filter(mito_chimeras, NumSupp >=3), aes(x = Source, fill = fusionType)) +
  geom_bar() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "False calls by each algorithm", subtitle = "minimum read support of 2", x = "Fusion Type", y = "Count")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))+
  facet_wrap(~Algorithm) +
  scale_y_log10()

```

```{r}
frequency_mito_chimeras <-  mito_chimeras %>% filter(fusionType == "Impossible") %>%
  group_by_all %>%
  mutate(Frequency = n()) %>% unique()

ggplot((frequency_mito_chimeras), aes(x = NumSupp, y= Frequency, colour = Algorithm, shape = factor(Platform)))+
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.5)+
  labs(title = "Frequency of impossible fusions detected",
    x = "Read Support")

ggplot((frequency_mito_chimeras), aes(x = NumSupp, y= Frequency, colour = Algorithm, shape = factor(Platform)))+
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.5)+
  labs(title = "Frequency of impossible fusions detected",
    x = "Read Support")+
  scale_y_log10()

ggplot((frequency_mito_chimeras), aes(x = NumSupp, y= Frequency, colour = Algorithm, shape = factor(Cell_Lines)))+
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.5)+
  labs(title = "Frequency of impossible fusions detected",
    x = "Read Support")+
  facet_zoom(xlim = c(1, 200))

ggplot(filter(mito_chimeras, NumSupp >=2), aes(x = Algorithm, y = NumSupp)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Cell_Lines)) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Read Support for False Fusions",
       x = "Fusion Type",
       y = "Read Support") +
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_wrap(~ fusionType) +  
  facet_zoom(ylim = c(1, 20))+  # Optional: Use log scale if appropriate
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```
```{r}
#filter self-fusions, e.g. paralogus genes 
self_LongGF <- LongGF %>% separate(V2, into = c("V2.1","V2.2"), sep=":", remove = FALSE) %>%  subset(V2.1 == V2.2) %>% rename("NumSupp"="V3")
self_FusionSeeker <- FusionSeeker %>%
  subset((Gene1 == Gene2) | 
         mapply(grepl, pattern = paste0(Gene1, "_PAR_Y"), x = Gene2) | 
         mapply(grepl, pattern = paste0(Gene2, "_PAR_Y"), x = Gene1))
self_GENION <- Genion %>% separate(V1, into = c("V1.1","V1.2"), sep="::", remove = FALSE) %>%  subset((V1.1 == V1.2) | mapply(grepl, pattern = paste0(V1.1, "_PAR_Y"), x = V1.2) | 
         mapply(grepl, pattern = paste0(V1.2, "_PAR_Y"), x = V1.1))
self_JAFFAL <- JAFFAL %>% separate(fusion.genes, into = c("V1.1","V1.2"), sep=":", remove = FALSE) %>% subset(V1.1 == V1.2)


selfish <- rbind(self_LongGF[c(5, 8:11)], self_FusionSeeker[c(4,10:13)]) %>% mutate(fusionType = "Self-fusion")

obv_false <- rbind(selfish, mito_chimeras)

ggplot(selfish, aes(x = Algorithm, fill = Algorithm))+
  geom_bar()+
  labs(title = "Frequency of self fusions",
    x = "Read Support")+
  facet_wrap(~ Cell_Lines)

ggplot(filter(obv_false, NumSupp >=3), aes(x = Algorithm, fill = fusionType)) +
  geom_bar() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Obvious false calls by each algorithm", subtitle = "minimum read support of 2", x = "Fusion Type", y = "Count")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))+
  facet_wrap(~Source)
2```

```{r}
# removing impossible and mitochondrial fusions from results
nomito_FusionSeeker <- subset(FusionSeeker, (Chrom1 != "chrM" & Chrom2 != "chrM"))
nomito_LongGF <- filter(LongGF, (!grepl("chrM:", V4, ignore.case = TRUE) & !grepl("chrM:", V5, ignore.case = TRUE)))
```



```{r}
selfless_LongGFK562 <- nomito_LongGFK562 %>% separate(V2, into = c("V2.1","V2.2"), sep=":", remove = FALSE) %>%  subset(V2.1 != V2.2)
selfless_LongGFMCF7 <- nomito_LongGFMCF7 %>% separate(V2, into = c("V2.1","V2.2"), sep=":", remove = FALSE) %>%  subset(V2.1 != V2.2)

selfless_FusionSeekerK562 <- nomito_FusionSeekerK562 %>%
  subset((Gene1 != Gene2) &
         !mapply(grepl, pattern = paste0(Gene1, "_PAR_Y"), x = Gene2) & 
         !mapply(grepl, pattern = paste0(Gene2, "_PAR_Y"), x = Gene1))

selfless_FusionSeekerMCF7 <- nomito_FusionSeekerMCF7 %>% subset((Gene1 != Gene2) & 
         !mapply(grepl, pattern = paste0(Gene1, "_PAR_Y"), x = Gene2) & 
         !mapply(grepl, pattern = paste0(Gene2, "_PAR_Y"), x = Gene1))

selfless <- rbind(mutate(rename(rbind(selfless_LongGFMCF7[c(5,(ncol(selfless_LongGFMCF7)-1) ,ncol(selfless_LongGFMCF7))], selfless_LongGFK562[c(5,(ncol(selfless_LongGFK562)-1) ,ncol(selfless_LongGFK562))]), "NumSupp"="V3"), Algorithm = "LongGF"),
                  mutate(rbind(selfless_FusionSeekerK562[c(4, (ncol(selfless_FusionSeekerK562)-1), ncol(selfless_FusionSeekerK562))], selfless_FusionSeekerMCF7[c(4, (ncol(selfless_FusionSeekerMCF7)-1), ncol(selfless_FusionSeekerMCF7))]) , Algorithm = "FusionSeeker"),
                  rename(mutate(rbind(nomito_GENIONK562[c(5, (ncol(nomito_GENIONK562)-1), ncol(nomito_GENIONK562))], nomito_GENIONMCF7[c(5, (ncol(nomito_GENIONMCF7)-1), ncol(nomito_GENIONMCF7))]), Algorithm = "Genion"), "NumSupp"="V5"), 
                  mutate(rename(rbind(nomito_JAFFALK562[c(11, (ncol(nomito_JAFFALK562)-1), ncol(nomito_JAFFALK562))], nomito_JAFFALMCF7[c(11, (ncol(nomito_JAFFALMCF7)-1), ncol(nomito_JAFFALMCF7))]), "NumSupp"="spanning.reads"), Algorithm = "JAFFAL"))

frequency_selfless <- selfless %>%
  group_by_all %>%
  mutate(Frequency = n()) %>% unique()

ggplot(frequency_selfless, aes(x = NumSupp, y= Frequency, colour = Algorithm, shape = factor(cell)))+
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.5)+
  labs(title = "Read Support of putative fusions",
    x = "Read Support",
    y= "count")+ 
  scale_y_log10()+
  scale_x_log10()


ggplot((subset(frequency_selfless, cell == "K562")), aes(x = NumSupp, y= Frequency, colour = Algorithm, shape = factor(platform)))+
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.5)+
  labs(title = "Read Support of putative fusions in K562",
    x = "Read Support",
    y = "count")+ 
  scale_y_log10()+
  scale_x_log10()

ggplot((subset(frequency_selfless, cell == "MCF7")), aes(x = NumSupp, y= Frequency, colour = Algorithm, shape = factor(platform)))+
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.5)+
  labs(title = "Read Support of putative fusions in MCF7",
    x = "Read Support")+ 
  scale_y_log10()+
  scale_x_log10()

ggplot((subset(selfless, cell == "MCF7")), aes(x = NumSupp, fill = Algorithm))+
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5)+
  labs(title = "Read Support of putative fusions in MCF7",
    x = "Read Support")+
  scale_x_log10()

ggplot((subset(selfless, cell == "MCF7")), aes(x = NumSupp, fill = Algorithm, after_stat(count)))+
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5 )+
  labs(title = "Read Support of putative fusions in MCF7",
    x = "Read Support")+
  scale_x_log10()+
  facet_zoom(xlim = c(1, 30), ylim = c(0,500))
```

```{r}
head(selfless_FusionSeekerK562[c(1:8, 10:12)])

consolidate_FusionSeekerK562<-selfless_FusionSeekerK562 %>%
  group_by(Gene1, Gene2, Chrom1, Chrom2, Source, platform, cell) %>%
  summarize(Total_NumSupp = sum(NumSupp))
consolidate_FusionSeekerMCF7<-selfless_FusionSeekerMCF7 %>%
  group_by(Gene1, Gene2, Chrom1, Chrom2, Source, platform, cell, ) %>%
  summarize(Total_NumSupp = sum(NumSupp))

consolidate_LongGFK562 <- selfless_LongGFK562 %>%
  group_by(V1,V2, V2.1, V2.2,  V4, V5, platform, cell) %>%
  summarize(Total_NumSupp = sum(V3))
consolidate_LongGFMCF7 <- selfless_LongGFMCF7 %>%
  group_by(V1,V2, V2.1, V2.2,  V4, V5, platform, cell) %>%
  summarize(Total_NumSupp = sum(V3))

consolidate_GENIONK562<- nomito_GENIONK562 %>%
  group_by(V1,V2, V3,  V4, V6, V7, Source, platform, cell) %>%
  summarize(Total_NumSupp = sum(V5))
consolidate_GENIONMCF7<- nomito_GENIONMCF7 %>%
  group_by(V1,V2, V3,  V4, V6, V7, Source, platform, cell) %>%
  summarize(Total_NumSupp = sum(V5))

consolidate_JAFFALK562<- nomito_JAFFALK562 %>%
  group_by(sample, fusion.genes, chrom1,  strand1, chrom2, strand2, Source, platform, cell) %>%
  summarize(Total_NumSupp = sum(spanning.reads))

consolidate_JAFFALMCF7 <- nomito_JAFFALMCF7 %>%
  group_by(sample, fusion.genes, chrom1,  strand1, chrom2, strand2, Source, platform, cell) %>%
  summarize(Total_NumSupp = sum(spanning.reads))

consolidated <- rbind(mutate(rbind(consolidate_LongGFK562, consolidate_LongGFMCF7)[c((ncol(consolidate_LongGFK562)-2): ncol(consolidate_LongGFK562))], Algorithm = "LongGF") , mutate(rbind(consolidate_FusionSeekerK562, consolidate_FusionSeekerMCF7)[c((ncol(consolidate_FusionSeekerMCF7)-2): ncol(consolidate_FusionSeekerMCF7))], Algorithm = "FusionSeeker"), mutate(rbind(consolidate_GENIONK562, consolidate_GENIONMCF7)[c((ncol(consolidate_GENIONK562)-2): ncol(consolidate_GENIONMCF7))], Algorithm = "Genion"), mutate(rbind(consolidate_JAFFALK562, consolidate_JAFFALMCF7)[c((ncol(consolidate_JAFFALK562)-2): ncol(consolidate_JAFFALK562))], Algorithm = "JAFFAL")) 

frequency_consolidated <- consolidated %>%
  group_by_all %>%
  mutate(Frequency = n()) %>% unique()

ggplot(frequency_consolidated, aes(x = Total_NumSupp, y= Frequency, colour = Algorithm, shape = factor(cell)))+
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.5)+
  labs(title = "Read Support of putative fusions with consolidated breakpoints",
    x = "Read Support",
    y= "count")+ 
  scale_y_log10()+
  scale_x_log10()


```
```{r}
# Found Fusions overlap, ignoring source file and read support, only looking at cell lines

set1_JAFFALK562 <- gsub( ":", "::", c(consolidate_JAFFALK562$fusion.genes))
set2_GenionK562 <- c(consolidate_GENIONK562$V2)
set3_LongGFK562 <- gsub( ":", "::", c(consolidate_LongGFK562$V2))

#Adjust FusionSeeker dataset
set4_FusionSeekerK562 <- consolidate_FusionSeekerK562
set4_FusionSeekerK562$Gene1 <- gsub("\\..*", "", set4_FusionSeekerK562$Gene1)
set4_FusionSeekerK562$Gene2 <- gsub("\\..*", "", set4_FusionSeekerK562$Gene2)
ensembl <- useMart("ensembl", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")
gene_info_1 <- getBM(attributes = c("external_gene_name", "ensembl_gene_id", "chromosome_name"),
                             filters = "ensembl_gene_id",
                             values = unique(set4_FusionSeekerK562$Gene1),
                             mart = ensembl)
gene_info_2 <- getBM(attributes = c("external_gene_name", "ensembl_gene_id", "chromosome_name"),
                             filters = "ensembl_gene_id",
                             values = unique(set4_FusionSeekerK562$Gene2),
                             mart = ensembl)

set4_FusionSeekerK562 <- left_join(set4_FusionSeekerK562, gene_info_1, by=c("Gene1"="ensembl_gene_id")) %>%
  left_join(gene_info_2, by=c("Gene2"="ensembl_gene_id")) %>% 
  mutate( #Some gene IDs (often belonging to antisense genes) do not have an external name. so we replace the empty string with the gene id
    external_gene_name.x = coalesce(na_if(external_gene_name.x, ""), Gene1),
    external_gene_name.y = coalesce(na_if(external_gene_name.y, ""), Gene2)
  ) %>%
  unite(fusion.gene, c(external_gene_name.x, external_gene_name.y), sep = "::", remove = FALSE) %>%
  unite(fusion.gene.id, c(Gene1, Gene2), sep = "::", remove = FALSE)

length(unique(set1_JAFFALK562))
length(unique(set2_GenionK562))
length(unique(set3_LongGFK562))
length(unique(set4_FusionSeekerK562$fusion.gene))

Fusion_Gene_sets_K562 <- list(
  JAFFAL = unique(set1_JAFFALK562),
  Genion = unique(set2_GenionK562),
  LongGF = unique(set3_LongGFK562),
  FusionSeeker = unique(set4_FusionSeekerK562$fusion.gene),
  Known = subset(known_fusions, Cell_Line=="K562" , select=Known_Fusion)$Known_Fusion 
)

Tools <- colnames(fromList(Fusion_Gene_sets_K562)[1:4])
upset(fromList(Fusion_Gene_sets), sets = Tools, order.by = "degree") 
upset_fusion_results <- fromList(Fusion_Gene_sets_K562)

complex_upset_data <- fromList(Fusion_Gene_sets_K562)
complex_upset_data$Known <- complex_upset_data$Known %>% as.logical() #%>% factor(levels = c(TRUE, FALSE))
ComplexUpset::upset(complex_upset_data, 
      Tools, 
      #sort_intersections_by='degree',
      base_annotations=list('Found Fusions'=intersection_size(counts = TRUE, mapping = aes(fill=Known), ))
      )

#Overall ReadSupport
Overall_JAFFALK562 <- consolidate_JAFFALK562 %>%
  group_by(fusion.genes, chrom1, chrom2, cell) %>%

  summarize(Overall_NumSupp = sum(Total_NumSupp))%>% mutate(Algorithm = "Genion")
Overall_LongGFK562 <- consolidate_LongGFK562 %>%
  group_by(V2, cell) %>%
  summarize(Overall_NumSupp = sum(Total_NumSupp))%>% mutate(Algorithm = "LongGF")

Overall_JAFFALMCF7 <- consolidate_JAFFALMCF7 %>%

  summarize(Overall_NumSupp = sum(Total_NumSupp)) %>% mutate(Algorithm = "JAFFAL")
Overall_FusionSeekerMCF7 <- consolidate_FusionSeekerMCF7 %>%
  group_by(Gene1, Gene2, Chrom1, Chrom2, platform, cell) %>%
  summarize(Overall_NumSupp = sum(Total_NumSupp))%>% mutate(Algorithm = "FusionSeeker")
Overall_GENIONMCF7 <- consolidate_GENIONMCF7 %>%
  group_by(V2, platform, cell) %>%
  summarize(Overall_NumSupp = sum(Total_NumSupp))%>% mutate(Algorithm = "Genion")
Overall_LongGFMCF7 <- consolidate_LongGFMCF7 %>%
  group_by(V2, platform, cell) %>%
  summarize(Overall_NumSupp = sum(Total_NumSupp))%>% mutate(Algorithm = "LongGF")

Overall_K562 <- rbind(Overall_JAFFALK562[c("cell","Overall_NumSupp","Algorithm")], Overall_FusionSeekerK562[c("cell","Overall_NumSupp","Algorithm")], Overall_GENIONK562[c("cell","Overall_NumSupp","Algorithm")], Overall_LongGFK562[c("cell","Overall_NumSupp","Algorithm")]) 


frequency_Overall_K562 <- Overall_K562 %>%
  group_by_all %>%
  mutate(Frequency = n()) %>% unique()

ggplot(frequency_Overall_K562, aes(x = Overall_NumSupp, y= Frequency, colour = Algorithm))+
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.5)+
  labs(title = "Read Support of putative fusions with consolidated breakpoints",
    x = "Read Support",
    y= "frequency")+ 
  scale_y_log10()+
  scale_x_log10()

ggplot((subset(Overall_K562, cell == "K562")), aes(x = Overall_NumSupp, fill = Algorithm))+
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5)+
  labs(title = "Read Support of putative fusions in K562",
    x = "Read Support")+
  scale_x_log10()

ggplot((subset(Overall_K562, cell == "K562")), aes(x = Overall_NumSupp, fill = Algorithm, after_stat(count)))+
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5)+
  labs(title = "Read Support of putative fusions in K562",
    x = "Read Support")+
  scale_x_log10()+
  facet_zoom(xlim=c(1,100), ylim=c(0,1500))

```
```{r}
#filter out overall = 1
Filt_Overall_JAFFALK562 <- Overall_JAFFALK562  %>% subset(Overall_NumSupp >1) 
Filt_Overall_GENIONK562 <- Overall_GENIONK562 %>% subset(Overall_NumSupp >1) 
Filt_Overall_LongGFK562 <- Overall_LongGFK562 %>% subset(Overall_NumSupp >1)
Filt_Overall_FusionSeekerK562 <- Overall_FusionSeekerK562  %>% subset(Overall_NumSupp >1)


#Adjust FusionSeeker dataset
Filt_Overall_FusionSeekerK562$Gene1 <- gsub("\\..*", "", Filt_Overall_FusionSeekerK562$Gene1)
Filt_Overall_FusionSeekerK562$Gene2 <- gsub("\\..*", "", Filt_Overall_FusionSeekerK562$Gene2)
ensembl <- useMart("ensembl", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")
gene_info_1 <- getBM(attributes = c("external_gene_name", "ensembl_gene_id", "chromosome_name"),
                             filters = "ensembl_gene_id",
                             values = unique(Filt_Overall_FusionSeekerK562$Gene1),
                             mart = ensembl)
gene_info_2 <- getBM(attributes = c("external_gene_name", "ensembl_gene_id", "chromosome_name"),
                             filters = "ensembl_gene_id",
                             values = unique(Filt_Overall_FusionSeekerK562$Gene2),
                             mart = ensembl)

Filt_Overall_FusionSeekerK562 <- left_join(Filt_Overall_FusionSeekerK562, gene_info_1, by=c("Gene1"="ensembl_gene_id")) %>%
  left_join(gene_info_2, by=c("Gene2"="ensembl_gene_id")) %>% 
  mutate( #Some gene IDs (often belonging to antisense genes) do not have an external name. so we replace the empty string with the gene id
    external_gene_name.x = coalesce(na_if(external_gene_name.x, ""), Gene1),
    external_gene_name.y = coalesce(na_if(external_gene_name.y, ""), Gene2)
  ) %>%
  unite(fusion.gene, c(external_gene_name.x, external_gene_name.y), sep = "::", remove = FALSE) %>%
  unite(fusion.gene.id, c(Gene1, Gene2), sep = "::", remove = FALSE)

Filt_Overall_FusionSeekerK562[c("cell", "Overall_NumSupp", "fusion.gene", "Algorithm")]


Fusion_Gene_sets_K562 <- list(
  JAFFAL = Filt_Overall_JAFFALK562$fusion.genes, #need to gsub the ::
  Genion = Filt_Overall_GENIONK562$V2,
  LongGF = Filt_Overall_LongGFK562$V2,
  FusionSeeker = Filt_Overall_FusionSeekerK562$fusion.gene,
  Known = subset(known_fusions, Cell_Line=="K562" , select=Known_Fusion)$Known_Fusion 
)

Tools <- colnames(fromList(Fusion_Gene_sets_K562)[1:4])
upset(fromList(Fusion_Gene_sets), sets = Tools, order.by = "degree") 
upset_fusion_results <- fromList(Fusion_Gene_sets_K562)

complex_upset_data <- fromList(Fusion_Gene_sets_K562)
complex_upset_data$Known <- complex_upset_data$Known %>% as.logical() #%>% factor(levels = c(TRUE, FALSE))
ComplexUpset::upset(complex_upset_data, 
      Tools, 
      #sort_intersections_by='degree',
      base_annotations=list('Found Fusions'=intersection_size(counts = TRUE, mapping = aes(fill=Known), ))
      )
